• Saṁyutta Nikāya 48.31 Linked Discourses 48.31
  • 4. Sukhindriyavagga 4. The Pleasure Faculty

Suddhikasutta Plain Version

“Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. “Mendicants, there are these five faculties. Katamāni pañca? What five? Sukhindriyaṁ, dukkhindriyaṁ, somanassindriyaṁ, domanassindriyaṁ, upekkhindriyaṁ—The faculties of pleasure, pain, happiness, sadness, and equanimity. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañcindriyānī”ti. These are the five faculties.”

Paṭhamaṁ.
